name: Cleaving Arc
description: A wide, wrath-fed swing that carves through every foe caught in the arc.

effects.text: Cleaving Arc hits every foe in the arc.
Some of the spent Wrath returns.

runes.name: Flooding Blade
runes.description: The arc widens into a full circle of steel, but each strike bites shallower.

runes.name: Bloodied Edge
runes.description: A heavier, slower cut that drinks less Wrath and gives some back.

runes.name: Toll of the Pit
runes.description: The arc demands a heavy tribute of Wrath and takes a heavy toll of flesh.

name: Whirlwind
description: The Bladewalker spins through the ring of enemies, dragging them off their feet.

effects.text: The spin gathers a little Wrath back.

runes.name: Storm of Blades
runes.description: The spin widens into a full gale of steel at the price of a slower recovery.

runes.name: Reaping Sweep
runes.description: A hungrier cut that tears Wrath from the fallen and returns it to the blade.

name: Riposte
description: The Bladewalker braces behind a raised guard and counters the next blow.

effects.text: A guard of steel absorbs incoming blows.
The counter cuts deep into the attacker.

runes.name: Iron Riposte
runes.description: A heavier guard that holds far longer, but the counter is blunted.

runes.name: Thorned Return
runes.description: A savage counter that trades part of the guard for raw damage.

runes.name: Blood Guard
runes.description: The guard drinks Wrath instead of health and lingers well past the fight.

name: War Cry
description: A battle shout that sharpens every swing and stirs the blood of the pit.

effects.text: The shout restores a quarter of the Wrath pool.

runes.name: Banner of Ruin
runes.description: The shout carries far and longer, but it cannot be repeated as often.

runes.name: Surge of Wrath
runes.description: A shorter, sharper shout that floods the blade with fury at once.

runes.name: Berserker Roar
runes.description: The loudest shout in the pit, paid for in blood and Wrath alike.

name: Executioner
description: A committed overhead cut meant to end a wounded enemy where it stands.

effects.text: Executioner drives the blade through the target.
Wounded foes fall all the faster.

runes.name: Ruin
runes.description: The cut is thrown with all remaining strength, Wrath and flesh alike.

runes.name: Blood Tithe
runes.description: A cheap, relentless cut that finishes anything already bleeding.

runes.name: Grave Cleave
runes.description: A faster, narrower cut made for draining foes before they can close.
